title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 218-10 Merrick Boulevard in Springfield Gardens, New York, as the "Cynthia Jenkins Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 218-10 Merrick Boulevard in Springfield Gardens, New York, as the "Cynthia Jenkins Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a New York City post office building after Cynthia Jenkins.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 218-10 Merrick Boulevard in Springfield Gardens, New York, as the "Cynthia Jenkins Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, staffing, or building operations.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
